# Vendored MapLibre GL JS

These files are copied unchanged from the `maplibre-gl` 6.0.0 npm package:

- `maplibre-gl.mjs`
- `maplibre-gl-shared.mjs`
- `maplibre-gl-worker.mjs`
- `maplibre-gl.css`

`LICENSE.txt` is the package's upstream license. Vendoring makes the mobile
showcase renderer and worker available when the device is offline.
